notes.title: We are a part of the Steam Space Exploration Fest! 👩‍🚀
notes.content:
Hello Androids! 🤖

We are very happy to be a part of this amazing event 🚀 and right now start your adventure as an android who is in charge of a spaceship colony in the demo version now! 👇

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42286609/89bdb077880c8cbdd265f6789469abdd93ad5469.png

About This Event:
Steam Space Exploration Fest celebrates games about spaaaaaace. Moons, planets, and galaxies far far away and the games that explore them are the focus of this event. ☄️

This event runs September 2 at 10:00 AM PDT (UTC-7) to September 9 at 10:00 AM PDT (UTC-7)


And don't forget to add the Prologue to your Steam Wishlist after playing the demo! 👇
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2025760/Android_Simulator_Prologue/

Have fun!
Android Simulator Team
